title: Showcase: Player buys / reviews a plan
description: See how a member signs in, opens their club plan from the header, and reviews purchase options when they have no active entitlement.

steps.title: Start at login
steps.body: This walkthrough uses the tutorial player account. Credentials are filled so you can focus on the Sign in control.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Simulate signing in. The next frame shows the Players home after authentication.

steps.title: Players home
steps.body: You land on the roster. Player accounts do not see Admin tools — plan management is via the $ control.
steps.resultNote: Header shows your name and the $ plan shortcut.

steps.title: Open your plan
steps.body: The $ control opens your membership / plan overlay from anywhere in the app.

steps.title: Plan screen
steps.body: Tutorial player has no current entitlement, so purchase options (Monthly membership, 5-visit pack) are visible with cash / online methods.
steps.resultNote: Seeded club plans and empty “current plan” state are intentional for this demo.

steps.title: Purchase options
steps.body: Scroll the plan dialog if needed. Note list prices, payment method (Cash vs Pay online), and consent for online pay.

steps.title: Close the plan
steps.body: When finished reviewing, close the overlay to return to Players.

steps.title: Back on Players
steps.body: Closing returns you to the roster. Admins can also open any member’s plan from the table.
steps.resultNote: Overlay dismissed; roster is interactive again.
